bus.description: School bus profile. In the real vehicle each zone below is meant to be fed by its own physical camera (front/left/right/rear). A single laptop webcam can only ever represent one of them at a time, so only FRONT is marked active for the webcam demo.

zones.name: FRONT
zones.note: Near-field trapezoid in front of the vehicle, where a driver's view over the hood is blocked. Sized for a laptop webcam framing a person standing a few metres away; not calibrated against real bus camera footage.

zones.name: LEFT
zones.note: Placeholder only. Requires a separate side-mounted camera; not exercised by a single front-facing webcam.

zones.name: RIGHT
zones.note: Placeholder only. Requires a separate side-mounted camera; not exercised by a single front-facing webcam.

zones.name: REAR
zones.note: Placeholder only. Requires a separate rear-mounted camera; not exercised by a single front-facing webcam.
